# Azelis is the reference innovation service provider in the speciality chemicals and food
# ingredients industry

[Touching the lives of people everywhere][74] [Our commitments to the wider community][75]

.

### Innovation

As a speciality distributor of chemicals and food ingredients, we’re now a fully integrated,
leading, innovative service provider. With innovation and collaboration at our heart, we believe
anything is possible.
* [Application laboratories][76]
* [Sampling and evaluation][77]
* [REACH compliance management][78]
* [International supply chain][79]

.

### Markets

Azelis services fifteen specific markets worldwide, bringing high-quality products, technical
expertise and local service support to each. Our international team is united in its hunger and
humility. Collaborating across 70+ laboratories to be a benchmark for innovation. A focus for
ambitious brands. And a catalyst that helps our customers to solve challenges and improve lives.
* [Life Sciences][80]
* [Industrial Chemicals][81]

.

### Customer Portal

The Azelis Customer Portal is a connected experience that inspires you with trends and inspirational
content for your selected markets, linking you to formulations, products, and related documentation.
From one digital experience you can order samples, request quotes and reorder products from Azelis.

Register at [Explore.Azelis.com][82]

[Visit the Customer Portal ][83]

regulators, and with you.* *

solutions, developing innovative ways to create value. We are Azelis.

We currently employ more than 4,100 people across the world in 64 countries. We value highly
competent, forward-looking people.

We take our responsibilities seriously and work with employees and stakeholders to reduce the
environmental impact of our work and to improve the social value in what we do, wherever we get the
opportunity.

chains.

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

[⟶][114]
[

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]
[

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs. 

[⟶][118]
[

### Our CDMO Services

][119]

We offer fully integrated **CDMO services **covering the entire process: from initial planning and
supply chain management to regulatory affairs, for your drug product.

[⟶][120]

## Our Network

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

## Our Network

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying

focus on their core competencies.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

][115]

Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

][117]

pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs.

coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## A vision for the industry of the future

Thanks to its innovative technology inspired by living matter, AFYREN produces biomolecules that
will form the basis of tomorrow’s ingredients. In addition to replacing petro-sourced products,
AFYREN and its industrial customers are part of a low-carbon, circular and regenerative bioeconomy,
contributing to better health for people and ecosystems.

**Nicolas Sordet and Jérémy Pessiot
**Co-founders of AFYREN

[afyren dirigeant]

## our commitments

### Living within our planetary means


**AFYREN offers solutions to tackle complex global issues for responsible development based on a
better balance between needs and resources. We are convinced that the sustainability of our planet
and our lifestyles depends on reducing humanity’s ecological footprint.**

Preserve natural resources and biodiversity
Our biobased solutions help to reduce dependence on fossil dependence on fossil fuels for many
everyday consumer products. Non-food biomass is converted in a reactor by a fermentation process
based on a 100% natural microbial community.
Reducing our environmental footprint
Processing operations are clean and energy-efficient, enabling us to reduce our carbon footprint in
the chemicals sector by a factor of 5. Our AFYREN NEOXY plant is based on the CHEMESIS platform to
develop synergies with the players on the platform: water, gas and electricity.
Reduce waste and optimize circularity
We are fully committed to a circular economy
circular economy, using by-products from organic raw materials as raw materials. From biomass
recovery to the “return to the soil” of the by-products of the fermentation process, our technology
is part of the zero waste approach.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

sells Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API), High Potency API, and API intermediates. Our unique

guideline, which is critical in achieving our global growth aspirations.

thousands of publications and by hundreds of clients in pharma, academia and health institutions.
biocrates has succeeded in building global community of more than 100 core facilities, CROs, service
customers & kit users to accelerate science using quantitative metabolomics.

biocrates enables scientists to establish and scale comprehensive metabolomics within days applying
kit technology and innovative software.

# Scaling metabolomics to your demand

## Services and partners

From study design consulting to sample measurement, data analytics and interpretation – biocrates
and its partners make metabolomics accessible.

[More info][107]

### Testimonial

biocrates’ team of experts is highly professional, the analytical team is meticulous and
knowledgeable about their workflow from sample prep to data analysis. The data analysis solutions
brought me the efficiency and enabled me to focus on result interpretation for my research program.
I am confident in continuing work with the biocrates team for my discoveries in future studies. 

**Ru Wei, PhD**
Scientific Director, Proteomics, Chemical Biology & Proteomics, Biogen USA

One challenge we face in clinical research is the limitation of the number of precious samples and
the unique nature of each sample. It can be difficult to acquire matched controls for every study.
We tested the QMDB and the various filter options matched well to study groups and the results
aligned with our control groups. Reassurance by the QMDB helped us to verify that our results were
within normal ranges and provide further power to our study.

**Teodoro Bottiglieri, PhD**
Director of Research, Center of Metabolomics; Baylor Scott & White Research Institute, USA

Our institute was looking for a standardized and validated approach to further expand our
metabolomics portfolio. In general, LC-MS-based methods lack comparability and robustness. In
addition, most self-developed or commercially available targeted approaches do not cover a broad
spectrum of metabolites. Therefore, we use the MxP® Quant 500 XL kit on a routine base as a
certified lab, because it is the most comprehensive solution for quantitative results on small
molecules and lipids and complementary to our NMR-based metabolomics panel.

**Dr. Sven Schuchardt**
Head of Bio- and Environmental Analytics, Fraunhofer ITEM – Institute of Toxicology and Experimental
Medicine, Germany

Our Metabolomics Core is involved in many long-term projects. Such projects require the generation
of reliable and comparable data over a long period of time, so data quality is of paramount
importance to us. We rely on the biocrates platform’s high-quality workflow and data analysis
pipeline, which helped us eliminate variability and generate reproducible data. Their technology has
also proven to be highly versatile and we could generate amazing insights in different indications
using a wide spectrum of sample matrices (e.g. biofluids, tissues, cells). Therefore, I highly
recommend the biocrates platform to any researcher looking to improve their data quality or just
getting started in metabolomics.

**Dr. Gernot Poschet**
Executive Director, Metabolomics Core Technology Platform, Heidelberg University & German Cancer
Research

## About Us

BYJU'S is India's largest ed-tech company and the creator of India's most loved school learning app.
Launched in 2015, BYJU'S offers highly personalised and effective learning programs for classes 1 -
12 (K-12), and aspirants of competitive exams like JEE, IAS etc. With 50 million registered students
and 3.5 million paid subscriptions, BYJU'S has become one of the most preferred education platforms
across the globe.

## What Makes Us Different?

# Personalised Learning

Our niche is creating personalised learning experiences for every type of learner. The BYJU'S way of
learning provides students a learning platform where they can learn, engage and be excited about
charting their own path to discover the world. BYJU'S - The Learning App brings together the best
teachers, technology, content, media for creating a seamless, world class learning experience for
each and every student.

## Why Choose Us?

Learning is pivotal for a student's success in academics and life. The Digital Age is deeply shaping
the way students learn and will also determine their future prospects. At BYJU'S, we encourage
students to embrace this fast, changing world and making them ready for tomorrow by being their
constant learning partner.

We craft learning journeys for every student that address their unique needs. We believe in the
power of one-to-one learning that addresses every child's learning needs, allows students to be
holistically involved in their education and be active, lifelong learners.

## Our Three Pillars

## Personalised Learning Journeys

Personalised Learning- is the foundation of our unique programs for students. Using knowledge
graphs, the program adapts and creates personalised learning journeys for students. It provides a
comprehensive coverage of over 1 lakh concepts with animated videos and questions, fun quizzes and
flashcards.

Based on the student's progress, personal learning profiles are created which help analyse strengths
and areas of improvement. Each concept gets tagged at different levels of difficulty to create a
smooth learning curve which keeps students motivated through any new learning challenge. Whenever
errors are made, motivating remedial methods are generated to strengthen and improve the student's
learning experience.

"**شیمی کاربردی روز**" مجله‌ای با دسترسی آزاد است که به صورت فصلی (در نسخه الکترونیکی) منتشر می‌شود و
یک رسانه ملی و بین المللی برای انتشار داده‌ها و دستاوردهای جدید محققان در رشته‌های مختلف مهندسی است که
در سال 1385 توسط دانشگاه سمنان تأسیس شد. رشته های اصلی این مجله شامل شیمی تجزیه، شیمی آلی، شیمی
معدنی، شیمی فیزیک، شیمی کاربردی، کاتالیزور، مهندسی واکنش شیمیایی، مهندسی شیمی محیطی، مهندسی سبز و
پایدار و مواد جدید حوزه­های شیمی کاربردی  می باشد. این مجله همچنین مقالات پژوهشی، کاربردی و مروری را
منتشر می کند. زبان مجله فارسی(سه شماره) و انگلیسی(یک شماره) و همه مقالات دارای چکیده و رفرنسهای به
زبان انگلیسی می باشند.

**«به اطلاع نویسندگان محترم می‌رساند مجله *شیمی کاربردی روز* در پایگاه استنادی Scopus نمایه شد.»**

 

** مقالات پر بازدید**
[ کپسوله کردن تنگستوفسفریک اسید در چارچوپ آلی-فلزی به عنوان کاتالیزور ناهمگن جهت انجام نوآرایی فرایز
فنیل استات با جهت گزینی در موقعیت پارا][59]
[ سنتز نانو دی اکسید تیتانیم دوپ شده با نیتروژن به منظور مدلسازی تصفیه فتوکاتالیستی پساب اسپنت
کاستیک صنایع پتروشیمی در نور مرئی با استفاده از روش طراحی آزمایش .][60]
[ سنتز نانو ذرات مغناطیسی Fe3O4 و کاربرد آن برای استخراج و پیش تغلیظ دارو از نمونه های محیطی][61]
[ شبیه سازی راکتور ریفرمینگ متان با بخار آب حاوی کاتالیست با هندسه کروی و مسطح][62]
[ الگوی شکافتگی اوربیتالهای d در میدان بلور][63]

Join us in the craft of sourdough baking, exploring the rich history, science, and art behind this
ancient bread. Together, we'll create crusty, soulful masterpieces right from your home oven.

## Texas-Proud and Meaning It

#### [Taco Loco][44]

Aside from BBQ, another food item that is typically associated with Texas is the lovely Taco! Get
the best information on this Texan (and American) favorite from tips and tricks to making the best
tacos, taco origins, and even in-depth information on the different specialty taco types!

#### [Butter Lasso][45]

Wrangle up your taste buds and get ready for a wild ride! Our blog is dedicated to exploring the
delicious world of cowboy butter. From savory recipes to creative pairing ideas, we'll show you how
to elevate your dishes with this flavorful spread. Grab your apron and let's get cooking!

#### [Lone Star Germania][46]

Willkommen! Discover the rich tapestry of German culture woven into the heart of Texas. From the
first waves of immigration to the enduring traditions, language, and cuisine, we explore the
fascinating stories and vibrant communities that have shaped the German experience in the Lone Star
State. Join us on this journey!

Immerse yourself in the rugged charm of the Lone Star State as we explore the rich traditions of
Texas cowboys. From the clink of spurs to the lore of the range, join us on a journey through the
history, lifestyle, and enduring spirit of the western frontier.

#### [Searing Tongues][48]

Dive into the fiery world of hot sauces, where bold flavors and daring heat levels reign supreme.
From the rich history of spicy condiments to the latest tongue-tingling creations, we'll explore the
diverse landscape of hot sauces, sharing expert tips, brand spotlights, and unforgettable culinary
adventures along the way.

#### [Mixology, TX][49]

Discover the vibrant, diverse world of Texas cocktails, from classic concoctions to innovative
creations. Join us as we explore the Lone Star State's thriving bar scene, meet the talented
mixologists behind the drinks, and uncover the stories and secrets that make Texas a true cocktail
destination. Cheers, y'all!

When it comes to enjoying the freshest flavors and optimal nutrition, timing matters. The “Peak

loam of Iowa to the volcanic soils of Hawaii, we explore the unique state soils that shape farming
communities. Discover the stories of resilient farmers, innovative practices, and the deep
connection between people and the land they cultivate.

Welcome to a fresh take on local farming in the cityscape! Dive into our city-specific guides and
uncover the vibrant world of community-supported agriculture. Discover local CSA programs, city
initiatives, and resources to connect with farm-fresh goodness right in your urban backyard. Join us
on this green journey.

friends. Let's get started!

## How to Eat

#### [Fast Forward][55]

Intermittent fasting alternates between periods of eating and fasting to potentially improve health
and promote weight loss.

#### [Keto Clarity Hub][56]

The ketogenic diet is a high-fat, low-carbohydrate eating plan designed to induce ketosis, a
metabolic state in which the body burns fat for fuel instead of carbohydrates.

#### [The Paleo Diet][57]

The paleo diet emphasizes eating like early humans, focusing on whole foods and excluding grains,
dairy, and processed items.

#### [The High Fat Diet][58]

The high-fat diet is rich in fats and often low in carbohydrates, aiming to promote ketosis or
improve body composition.

#### [Beyond Grains][59]

A no-grains diet eliminates all grain products, including wheat, rice, and corn, focusing on other
whole foods.

#### [The Diet Decoder][60]

Your no-nonsense guide to understanding today's popular diets. Here, we cut through the hype to
explore the science and real-world results behind each eating plan.

#### [Flex Feast & Flora][61]

Embark on a journey where nutritious plants meet occasional meat indulgence. The flexitarian diet
offers a balanced, eco-friendly approach to eating—less meat, more plants, without strict rules.
Discover delicious versatility and health benefits in every bite, tailored for the modern, conscious
eater. Welcome to a world of flexible dining.

#### [Lactose Intolerance 101][62]

Discover everything you need to know about living with lactose intolerance. From understanding the
causes and symptoms to finding the best lactose-free alternatives, our blog is here to guide you
through your journey. Join us as we explore the world of lactose intolerance and learn to thrive
without dairy.

foods for optimal health. Dive into recipes, tips, and the science behind this lifestyle, ensuring a
delicious balance that nurtures both body and planet. Join us as we explore the art of Pegan living.

# Home Page

Marine Deck Maintenance Ship Hold Tank Cleaning Rigs & Oilfield Water Treatment

### Featured Marine Chemicals

#### Oil Spill Dispersant

Rapid-action dispersant that breaks down oil slicks into biodegradable microdroplets for safer,
faster marine and industrial cleanup.

#### Air Cooler Cleaning Chemical

Specially formulated cleaner that removes scale, dust, and microbial buildup to enhance air cooler
efficiency and airflow.

#### Vapor Treatment

High-performance volatile corrosion inhibitor that protects metal surfaces in closed steam and vapor
systems.

#### Rust Stain Remover

Quickly eliminates stubborn rust stains from decks, hulls, and painted surfaces without abrasion or
corrosion.

#### Descaling Liquid

Effectively removes lime and scale deposits from boilers and coolers.

#### Heavy Duty Degreaser

Heavy-duty marine degreaser engineered to dissolve tough grease, oil, and sludge from engine rooms,
bilges, and industrial surfaces.

### Featured Ship Hold & Tank Cleaning

#### Slip Barrier Coat

Polymer based product, forms a protective, non-stick barrier on cargo holds to prevent material
adhesion and ease post-discharge cleaning.

#### RX Tuff High Foam

High Foam, higher power - designed for hold cleaning and general degreasing.

#### Lime Remover HD

Innovative, concentrated liquid product specifically engineered to attack, penetrate and remove lime
deposit accumulations from cargo and storage tanks.

#### RXSOL PCS Hold Clean

Effectively removes, Coal Carbon, pet coke and mineral & lime deposits from cargo holds and tanks.

#### Alkaline Safety Liquid

Non-caustic alkaline cleaner formulated to remove vegetable oils, animal fats, hydrocarbons, lube
oils, and petcoke residues from cargo tanks.

#### Iron Ore Cargo Clean

Concentrated blend of RXSOL proprietory formulated various products, which is specifically designed
for the rapid removal of rust, while providing phosphatized ferrous metal surface.

### Featured Rigs & Oilfield Chemicals

#### RXSOL RIG WASH

Emulsifier with powerful penetrating agents, corrosion inhibitors and surfactants. Quickly removes
oil, grease, gimres - best for cleaning double bottom tanks

#### Corrosion Inhibitor for Oil Pipeline

A highly effective, film-forming corrosion control agent specifically designed for oil and gas
production and transmission systems operating under sour gas (H2S) and acid gas (CO2) conditions.

#### Crude Oil Defoamer

Defoamer designed to effectively control foam in crude oil processing and refinery operations.

#### H2S Scavenger

Wide range of Hydrogen Sulfide Scavenger to elimiate traces of H2S fouling.

#### Scale Inhibitor

Specially designed to inhibit the scale formation in polyamide-, celluloseacetate- and
polyethermembranes with anionically charged surface.

#### Flocculants

Specialized well oil flocculant that aggregates suspended oils and solids for improved separation
and wastewater clarity.

### Featured Water Treatment Chemicals

#### Corrosion & Scale Inhibitors

Corrosion & Scale Inhibitors for cooling towers - multi metal protection, as well as for boiler
treatment.

#### Biocides

Closed-loop & Open-loop Biocides for broad spectrum microbe fighting.

#### pH Booster

Solutions to maintain desired alkalinity in boiler systems.

#### Sludge Conditioners

Heavy-duty cleaning of sludge from Boilers - reduces maintenance cost by more than 150%.

#### Oxygen Scavengers

Large range of Oxygen Scavengers for Boilers - eliminates traces of Oxygen from systems effectively.

#### One Shot Treatment

Use one shot powder/liquid treatment for your cooling/boiler unit which contains - corrosion/scale
inhibitor, alkalinity booster, oxygen scavenger, etc.

Marine Deck Maintenance Ship Hold Tank Cleaning Rigs & Oilfield Water Treatment

### Featured Marine Chemicals

#### Oil Spill Dispersant

Rapid-action dispersant that breaks down oil slicks into biodegradable microdroplets for safer,
faster marine and industrial cleanup.

#### Air Cooler Cleaning Chemical

Specially formulated cleaner that removes scale, dust, and microbial buildup to enhance air cooler
efficiency and airflow.

#### Vapor Treatment

High-performance volatile corrosion inhibitor that protects metal surfaces in closed steam and vapor
systems.

#### Rust Stain Remover

Quickly eliminates stubborn rust stains from decks, hulls, and painted surfaces without abrasion or
corrosion.

#### Descaling Liquid

Effectively removes lime and scale deposits from boilers and coolers.

#### Heavy Duty Degreaser

Heavy-duty marine degreaser engineered to dissolve tough grease, oil, and sludge from engine rooms,
bilges, and industrial surfaces.

### Featured Ship Hold & Tank Cleaning

#### Slip Barrier Coat

Polymer based product, forms a protective, non-stick barrier on cargo holds to prevent material
adhesion and ease post-discharge cleaning.

#### RX Tuff High Foam

High Foam, higher power - designed for hold cleaning and general degreasing.

#### Lime Remover HD

Innovative, concentrated liquid product specifically engineered to attack, penetrate and remove lime
deposit accumulations from cargo and storage tanks.

#### RXSOL PCS Hold Clean

Effectively removes, Coal Carbon, pet coke and mineral & lime deposits from cargo holds and tanks.

#### Alkaline Safety Liquid

Non-caustic alkaline cleaner formulated to remove vegetable oils, animal fats, hydrocarbons, lube
oils, and petcoke residues from cargo tanks.

#### Iron Ore Cargo Clean

Concentrated blend of RXSOL proprietory formulated various products, which is specifically designed
for the rapid removal of rust, while providing phosphatized ferrous metal surface.

### Featured Rigs & Oilfield Chemicals

#### RXSOL RIG WASH

Emulsifier with powerful penetrating agents, corrosion inhibitors and surfactants. Quickly removes
oil, grease, gimres - best for cleaning double bottom tanks

#### Corrosion Inhibitor for Oil Pipeline

A highly effective, film-forming corrosion control agent specifically designed for oil and gas
production and transmission systems operating under sour gas (H2S) and acid gas (CO2) conditions.

#### Crude Oil Defoamer

Defoamer designed to effectively control foam in crude oil processing and refinery operations.

#### H2S Scavenger

Wide range of Hydrogen Sulfide Scavenger to elimiate traces of H2S fouling.

#### Scale Inhibitor

Specially designed to inhibit the scale formation in polyamide-, celluloseacetate- and
polyethermembranes with anionically charged surface.

#### Flocculants

Specialized well oil flocculant that aggregates suspended oils and solids for improved separation
and wastewater clarity.

### Featured Water Treatment Chemicals

#### Corrosion & Scale Inhibitors

Corrosion & Scale Inhibitors for cooling towers - multi metal protection, as well as for boiler
treatment.

#### Biocides

Closed-loop & Open-loop Biocides for broad spectrum microbe fighting.

#### pH Booster

Solutions to maintain desired alkalinity in boiler systems.

#### Sludge Conditioners

Heavy-duty cleaning of sludge from Boilers - reduces maintenance cost by more than 150%.

#### Oxygen Scavengers

Large range of Oxygen Scavengers for Boilers - eliminates traces of Oxygen from systems effectively.

#### One Shot Treatment

Use one shot powder/liquid treatment for your cooling/boiler unit which contains - corrosion/scale
inhibitor, alkalinity booster, oxygen scavenger, etc.

eChemNetwork is a global B2B platform connecting chemical, pharmaceutical, industrial, laboratory,
engineering, manufacturers, suppliers, exporters, importers, distributors, buyers, and service
providers worldwide.

## ? Is registration free?

Yes. Companies can create a business profile free of charge. Premium membership and advertising
plans are available for additional exposure and lead generation.

## ? How can buyers contact suppliers?

Buyers can search products or companies and submit inquiries directly through supplier profile pages
and product listings.

## ? Can I advertise my company?

Yes. eChemNetwork offers Featured Listings, Banner Advertising, Sponsored Products, Digital
Marketing, Email Marketing, and various branding opportunities.

## ? Which industries are covered?

Chemical, Pharmaceutical, API, Agrochemical, Petrochemical, Laboratory, Specialty Chemicals,
Engineering, Packaging, Industrial Equipment, and many other sectors.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about eChemNetwork, business listings, chemical suppliers,
manufacturers, buyers, membership, and advertising services.

## ? What is eChemNetwork?

eChemNetwork is a global B2B platform connecting chemical, pharmaceutical, industrial, laboratory,
engineering, manufacturers, suppliers, exporters, importers, distributors, buyers, and service
providers worldwide.

## ? Is registration free?

Yes. Companies can create a business profile free of charge. Premium membership and advertising
plans are available for additional exposure and lead generation.

## ? How can buyers contact suppliers?

Buyers can search products or companies and submit inquiries directly through supplier profile pages
and product listings.

## ? Can I advertise my company?

Yes. eChemNetwork offers Featured Listings, Banner Advertising, Sponsored Products, Digital
Marketing, Email Marketing, and various branding opportunities.

## ? Which industries are covered?

Chemical, Pharmaceutical, API, Agrochemical, Petrochemical, Laboratory, Specialty Chemicals,
Engineering, Packaging, Industrial Equipment, and many other sectors.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every

traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

######  

## The Supply Chain Is Complex. We Make It Work For You.

You know that the supply chain can be disrupted at any time…but that doesn’t change your customer
demands. That’s why you need a partner who can navigate complexity, prepare for uncertainty, and
plan in advance so you aren’t left short.

You have a business to run. You need your materials on time, no matter what is happening in the
world. We’ve built a system that serves your market and keeps your business running.

How do we do that?

##### A Worldwide Supplier Network

We’ve developed a network of suppliers from around the globe. Each one has been chosen because they
offer high-quality materials at competitive prices, while maintaining best-in-class turnaround time
and technical support.

##### An Ability To Find Materials

This global network gives us the ability to scour the globe in search of what you need. National and
international relationships give you the edge when materials are hard to find or supplies are
running short.

##### Experienced, Personal Service

We listen and adhere to your specifications, equipment and packaging preferences, and delivery
hours. We monitor your shipment, noting delivery schedules and delay alerts, if any. We record lot
numbers and archive them for historical reference.

##### We Handle The Logistics

Paperwork isn’t your job. It’s ours, and we make sure you meet all regulations and requirements. A
Certificate of Analysis accompanies each shipment. We also offer safety and handling assistance as
well as storage and equipment options.

## Guaranteed Reliability: Protect Your Products and Your Reputation

One outcome of a global supply chain is that it’s hard for you to know if your materials are meeting
domestic and international standards. But we make sure of that for you.

We provide a wide array of ingredients, chemicals and agents tested and confirmed for products
ranging from food applications and industrial cleaners to high-end personal care and specialty
products. We emphasize quality control.Ingredients, additives and agents are tested and confirmed
for purity and safety. Our suppliers are registered with the FDA and USP and have one or more of the
following certifications:

*“For over 20 years, our family has been delivering to customers around the world. We’re proud to
keep every promise we make.”*

###### Brad Graham | Owner / President — Graham Chemical

## Custom Manufacturing So You Can Get What You Need

Sometimes, the chemical or ingredient you need isn’t available. That’s why we’ve contracted with
trusted manufacturers to create the right chemical.

[Chemical manufacturing equipment][Chemical manufacturing equipment]

### Our Custom Manufacturing Network

Our network includes an extensive portfolio of technologies and top-of-the-line reactors,
evaporators, spray dryers, and particle processing equipment, available to produce your new complex
molecules utilizing multi-step synthesis. Our sales and technical professionals work side by side
with you to understand your process and develop the chemical that meets your specifications and
standards.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform complet

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

> ## Natural Extracts for the flavour and fragrance industry.

## Products and Services

We manufacture and supply over 1,000 speciality Aroma Chemicals and Natural Extracts around the
world.

#### F&F Product Compendium

### Speciality Aroma Chemicals and Natural Extracts for the flavour and fragrance industry.

Natara manufactures the largest portfolio of speciality Aroma Chemicals and Natural Extracts, and
its F&F Product Compendium is the one-stop-shop for the global flavour and fragrance industry.

[Learn more][42]

#### TASTE’WELL F&B PRODUCTS

### Speciality products for the food and beverage wellness industry.

Taste’Well is a range of unique plant extracts designed for the food and beverage wellness industry.
The raw material selection and gentle extraction process deliver the tastiest solutions. With us,
there is no compromise on sensory experience or solubility.

[Learn more][43]

#### SUSTAINABILITY

### We are on a mission to make the world taste and smell better, responsibly.

We are committed to being a leader in sustainability in the flavour and fragrance industry. Under
new ownership, we are embarking on a long-term roadmap, setting ambitious environmental, social and
governance targets.

[Learn more][52]

#### INNOVATION

### Innovation is at the heart of our strategy and we lead the way on product and processes.

Our world-class R&D team partners with customers to create unique Natural Extracts and highly
complex Aroma Chemicals that make the difference in their products, and are recognised for their
superior quality and performance.

[Learn more][53]

### We give customers peace of mind

Customers choose Natara and stay with us long-term for the peace of mind that we provide, through
our global manufacturing capability, diverse portfolio of consistently high-quality products, and
innovative approach.

#### Global manufacturing capability

We manufacture across three continents: Europe, Asia and America. As a result we can provide
consistency of supply, contingency planning and regulatory knowledge for all our customers around
the world.

#### High quality, consistent products

We lead the way on consistently high-quality products, and provide a one-stop-shop for both Natural
Extracts and Aroma Chemicals, that makes life easier for our customers.

#### Product and process innovation

We partner with customers to create innovative product solutions that add real value to their
business, and we continuously improve manufacturing and supply chain processes for them.

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of
scientific excellence, attractive to both industrial and academic scientists in Pharmaceutical &
Novel Drug Delivery systems of Relevant Field.

### Sessions and Tracks


**Track 1: [Pharmaceutics][82]**

[Pharmaceutics][83] are one of the primary factors for developing a [drug][84] as it involves in
converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

### Strategic Insights

Convert data into clear narratives on risk, growth pockets and profit pools.

### Actionable Strategies

Translate insight into prioritised initiatives, investments and go to market plays.

### Revenue Impact

Execute with confidence and measure the effect on growth, margin and resilience.

## Our Core Capabilities

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

[Read More about Market Sizing and Forecasting][48]
[Market Sizing and Forecasting]

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

[Read More about Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis][49]
[Competitive intelligence illustration showing business analytics]

## Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights

Our Customer, Channel & Use Case Insights reveal what drives adoption, loyalty, and value creation.
We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

[Read More about Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights][50]

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

[[EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][22]

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

## How To Import Your Ingredients

**We handle the complexity. You receive the product.**

Sourcing ingredients directly from overseas manufacturers can unlock significantly better pricing
and access to the full range of certified grades. Synergy manages the entire import process on your
behalf — from supplier to your warehouse door.

01
Tell us what you need

quantity and any grade requirements (FCC, BP, USP, food grade, pharma grade). We'll confirm whether
we can source it and from which certified manufacturer.

02
Receive your quote within 24 hours

We respond with full pricing FOB (Free On Board) or CIF (Cost, Insurance and Freight) sourced from
verified, GMP-certified manufacturers across Asia, Europe and North America. Your quote includes
availability, lead time and the relevant product certificates.

03
Synergy manages the entire import

This is where we do the work you shouldn't have to. We handle everything: purchase from the
manufacturer, international freight booking, Australian customs clearance, biosecurity documentation
and border processing. You are not dealing with freight forwarders, customs brokers or overseas
suppliers. One contact. Full visibility.

04
Delivered to your door, fully documented

Your imported product arrives at your facility with all paperwork in order — Certificate of
Analysis, Safety Data Sheet, country of origin, and any additional certifications required for your
compliance team. We use Australia's leading freight carriers for the final domestic leg.

[Zydus Srishti]

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

[View More][24]
